citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail. UCI. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33
sampling: 400 uniformly sampled non-null customer IDs, all their source rows; plus 10 anonymous invoices per calendar month, all their anonymous rows; original row order preserved. No cleaning or synthetic corruption applied.
limitations: Not representative at row/invoice level; known and anonymous groups have different inclusion mechanisms. Observed history is limited to the source window. Partial December 2011. No population revenue estimates or missingness prevalence claims.
